matrix_profile_admission.normalization: Selected compiler alias, isolated source root, one contraction flag and exact diagnostic version token only.

timing_comparison.limits: Diagnostic observation only. No release pass; kernel wall includes internal waits, scheduling and observer effects. Never sum overlapping workers.
